title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Global Financial Management
description: In this advanced course, we will dive deep into the critical concepts and principles of global financial management, including the goal and approach of financial management in businesses and organisations.
longDescription: In this advanced course, we will dive deep into the critical concepts and principles of global financial management, including the goal and approach of financial management in businesses and organisations. You will learn about the balance of payments, international funds flow, and exchange rate systems used by various governments. We will also explore the fascinating world of currency exchange rate forecasting techniques and derivatives. In addition, we will analyse the role and recent trends in international equity and debt markets, including the valuation of foreign stocks and instruments. You will gain a comprehensive understanding of foreign direct investment (FDI) and learn how to value a foreign target and estimate the cost of capital. Finally, we will explore the unique risks MNCs face in today's global business environment and develop practical skills in risk management and trade financing to manage them effectively.
courseDetails: Explain how the exchange rate moves, how it is measured, and how equilibrium is determined. Describe the exchange rate systems used by various governments. Explain different currencies’ derivatives. To elaborate currency exchange rate forecasting techniques. Critically analyse the concept and role of international equity markets. Explain the recent trends and market structure of international equality markets. Analyse the valuation of foreign stocks. Understand the international debt markets and instruments. Critically analyze the concept and importance of Foreign Direct investment. Explain the recent trends in Foreign Direct investment. Analyse the model for valuing a foreign target. Explain how to estimate the cost of capital. Gain a comprehensive understanding of the unique country and financial risks that MNCs face in today's global business environment. Develop practical risk management and trade financing skills to effectively manage risk in international business operations. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; The Landscape of Global Financial Management: Understanding Exchange Rate System: Understanding the International Equity and Debt Markets: Understanding the Dynamics of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI): Country Risk Analysis, International Banking and Trade Finance:
